items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Then he said to me, said, well, there's a drum player named Guy [Wattle]... But they called him Guy [Wattle].

ctx.x: Well, there's a drummer they had. When they came back to Chicago the second time, Hawk wasn't with them then. Hawk wasn't with them then. Then he said to me, said, well, there's a drum player named Guy [Wattle], which is the Creole name they called this fellow. We (unintelligible).
